name: Docks
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. To the west you can see Wharf street, and to
desc3: the east there is a small, run-down shack. From the look of it, it
desc4: looks to be a caretaker's house of some sort. River street runs
desc5: parallel to Wharf street to the south. Off to the north, a rickety
desc6: boat launch juts out into the fast-flowing waters of the Silver river.
